// BEGIN src/water-jumps.js
// Salts breus sobre ones per a motos aquàtiques i windsurf.
 // Física relativa a la superfície ja mostrejada al render: sense
 // tocar la navegació, el control ni el nivell de flotació dels altres bucs.
window.HUNTER_WATER_JUMPS=Object.freeze({
  update(v,dt,time,waterAt,maxSpeed){
    if(v.t!=='moto_aquatica'&&v.t!=='windsurf')return {lift:0,pitch:0};
    const jet=v.t==='moto_aquatica',
          minSpeed=jet?18:12,
          // Les dues taules aprofiten el mateix pendent d'ona que
          // feia enlairar l'antiga moto aquàtica.
          configRise=.14,
          span=4.8,
          state=v.waveJump||(v.waveJump={lift:0,vy:0,cooldown:0,airborne:false,jumps:0});
    if(dt<=0)return {lift:state.lift,pitch:0};
    const step=Math.min(dt,.08);
    state.cooldown=Math.max(0,state.cooldown-step);
    if(!state.airborne&&v.v>minSpeed&&state.cooldown<=0){
      const fx=-Math.sin(v.hd),fz=-Math.cos(v.hd),
            ahead=waterAt(v.x+fx*span,v.z+fz*span,time),
            behind=waterAt(v.x-fx*span,v.z-fz*span,time),
            rise=ahead-behind;
      // És el pendent de l'ona frontal (no una oscil·lació aleatòria):
      // només es pot enlairar quan la proa puja prou de pressa.
      if(rise>configRise){
        const speed=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,v.v/(maxSpeed||30)));
        state.airborne=true;
        // Windsurf: antic salt de moto. Moto: altura doble
        // (velocitat inicial multiplicada per sqrt(2)).
        const formerJetVy=2.55+speed*1.12+Math.min(.9,rise*.5);
        state.vy=formerJetVy*(jet?Math.SQRT2:1);
        state.lift=.01;
        state.jumps++;
      }
    }
    if(state.airborne){
      const next=state.lift+state.vy*step-4.9*step*step;
      state.vy-=9.8*step;
      if(next<=0){
        state.airborne=false;state.lift=0;state.vy=0;
        state.cooldown=jet?.9:1.05;
      }else state.lift=Math.min(jet?4.8:2.4,next);
    }
    const pitch=state.airborne
      ?Math.max(-.22,Math.min(.26,state.vy*.045))
      :0;
    return {lift:state.lift,pitch};
  }
});

;
// END src/water-jumps.js
// BEGIN src/movement-fx.js
// Esteles i esquitxos agrupats en només quatre malles instanciades.
// El sistema és visual i no consumeix mai el RNG de generació d'illes.
window.HUNTER_MOVEMENT_FX=Object.freeze({
 create(T,{scene,quality='desktop',waveModel,waterTime,waterBed}){
   const settings={
     // Enemics: distàncies LOD pròpies segons qualitat, sense més draw calls.
     desktop:{wake:210,ripple:64,air:155,smoke:105,range:250,enemyRange:240,spacing:1},
     mobile:{wake:110,ripple:40,air:86,smoke:64,range:185,enemyRange:160,spacing:1.35},
     ultra:{wake:60,ripple:24,air:48,smoke:36,range:140,enemyRange:95,spacing:1.9}
   }[quality]||{wake:210,ripple:64,air:155,smoke:105,range:250,enemyRange:200,spacing:1};
   const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v)),rand=Math.random,
     dummy=new T.Object3D(),face=new T.Quaternion(),color=new T.Color();
   const stats={
     emitted:{wake:0,ripple:0,air:0,smoke:0},
     active:{wake:0,ripple:0,air:0,smoke:0},
     steps:0,droplets:0,landTrails:0,waterTrails:0,downwash:0,
     drawMeshes:0,resets:0,quality
   };
   let waterVisible=true,previousFootBucket=null,previousSwimBucket=null;
   const groups={};
   function pool(name,capacity,flat){
     const geometry=new T.PlaneGeometry(1,1);
     if(flat)geometry.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
     const alpha=new T.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(capacity),1),
       tint=new T.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(capacity*3),3),
       seabed=new T.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(capacity),1);
     for(const attr of [alpha,tint,seabed])attr.setUsage(T.DynamicDrawUsage);
     geometry.setAttribute('fxAlpha',alpha);
     geometry.setAttribute('fxTint',tint);
     geometry.setAttribute('fxBed',seabed);
     const material=new T.ShaderMaterial({
       uniforms:{time:waterTime},transparent:true,depthWrite:false,
       side:T.DoubleSide,
       vertexShader:[
         'uniform float time;',
         'attribute float fxAlpha,fxBed;',
         'attribute vec3 fxTint;',
         'varying vec2 uvFX;varying vec3 tintFX;varying float alphaFX;',
         waveModel.glsl,
         'void main(){',
         '  vec4 p=instanceMatrix*vec4(position,1.);',
         flat?'  p.y+=hunterWaveHeight(p.xz,time,fxBed);':'',
         '  uvFX=uv;tintFX=fxTint;alphaFX=fxAlpha;',
         '  gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*p;',
         '}'
       ].join('\n'),
       fragmentShader:[
         'varying vec2 uvFX;varying vec3 tintFX;varying float alphaFX;',
         'void main(){',
         '  vec2 q=(uvFX-.5)*2.;float dist=length(q);',
         name==='ripple'
           ?'  float shape=smoothstep(.38,.6,dist)*(1.-smoothstep(.76,.98,dist));'
           :name==='wake'
             ?'  float shape=pow(max(0.,1.-dist*dist),1.9)*(.76+.12*sin(q.x*19.)+.12*cos(q.y*17.));'
             :'  float shape=pow(max(0.,1.-dist*dist),2.15);',
         '  float a=clamp(shape*alphaFX,0.,.80);',
         '  if(a<.008)discard;',
         '  gl_FragColor=vec4(tintFX,a);',
         '#include <tonemapping_fragment>',
         '#include <colorspace_fragment>',
         '}'
       ].join('\n')
     });
     const mesh=new T.InstancedMesh(geometry,material,capacity);
     mesh.name='hunter-motion-'+name;
     mesh.renderOrder=flat?4:5;
     mesh.instanceMatrix.setUsage(T.DynamicDrawUsage);
     mesh.frustumCulled=false;mesh.count=0;mesh.visible=false;
     scene.add(mesh);
     groups[name]={mesh,geometry,material,alpha,tint,seabed,
       flat,capacity,particles:[]};
   }
   pool('wake',settings.wake,true);
   pool('ripple',settings.ripple,true);
   pool('air',settings.air,false);
   pool('smoke',settings.smoke,false);
   function emit(kind,p){
     if(!waterVisible&&(kind==='wake'||kind==='ripple'))return false;
     const g=groups[kind];if(!g)return false;
     const list=g.particles;
     if(list.length>=g.capacity)list.shift();
     color.setHex(p.color??0xffffff);
     list.push({
       x:p.x,z:p.z,y:p.y||0,vx:p.vx||0,vz:p.vz||0,vy:p.vy||0,
       width:p.width??1,length:p.length??p.width??1,
       heading:p.heading||0,bed:p.bed??(g.flat?waterBed(p.x,p.z):0),
       age:0,life:p.life??1.2,alpha:p.alpha??.7,
       growth:p.growth??1.4,gravity:p.gravity||0,ground:p.ground??-Infinity,
       cr:color.r,cg:color.g,cb:color.b
     });
     stats.emitted[kind]++;return true;
   }
   function footstep(x,z,depth,side=1){
     if(depth<.15||depth>2.15||!waterVisible)return false;
     const bed=waterBed(x,z),power=clamp(depth/1.25,.3,1);
     emit('ripple',{x,z,y:.12,bed,width:1.6+power*.7,
       length:1.35+power*.6,life:1.04,alpha:.72,growth:1.9,color:0xdbf9fa});
     const surface=waveModel.height(x,z,waterTime.value,bed);
     for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
       const angle=(i+.18*rand())*Math.PI*2/3+side*.75,
         speed=1.3+power*2+rand()*.7;
       emit('air',{x:x+Math.cos(angle)*.09,z:z+Math.sin(angle)*.09,
         y:surface+.22,bed,
         vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed*.44,vz:Math.sin(angle)*speed*.44,
         vy:1.7+power*1.6+rand()*.5,gravity:8,
         ground:surface+.02,
         width:.08+power*.075,life:.6,
         alpha:.94,growth:.45,color:0xcdf7ff});
       stats.droplets++;
     }
     stats.steps++;return true;
   }
   function playerStep({phase,x,z,heading,moving,swimming,inVehicle,falling,surfaceAt,groundAt}){
     const bucket=Math.floor(phase/Math.PI);
     if(previousFootBucket===null){previousFootBucket=bucket;return false}
     if(bucket===previousFootBucket)return false;
     previousFootBucket=bucket;
     if(!moving||swimming||inVehicle||falling)return false;
     const side=bucket%2?1:-1,
       px=x+Math.cos(heading)*side*.32-Math.sin(heading)*.24,
       pz=z-Math.sin(heading)*side*.32-Math.cos(heading)*.24;
     return footstep(px,pz,surfaceAt(px,pz)-groundAt(px,pz),side);
   }
   function swimStroke({phase,x,z,heading,swimming,crawling,moving,surfaceAt}){
     const bucket=Math.floor((phase+Math.PI/2)/Math.PI);
     if(!swimming||!crawling||!moving||!waterVisible){previousSwimBucket=null;return false}
     if(previousSwimBucket===null){previousSwimBucket=bucket;return false}
     if(bucket===previousSwimBucket)return false;
     previousSwimBucket=bucket;
     // Alternam braços: esquitx visible a banda i banda al llarg del crol.
     const side=bucket%2?1:-1,rx=Math.cos(heading),rz=-Math.sin(heading),
       fx=-Math.sin(heading),fz=-Math.cos(heading);
     for(const s of [-1,1]){
       const x0=x+rx*s*.72+fx*.45,z0=z+rz*s*.72+fz*.45,
         surface=surfaceAt(x0,z0),bed=waterBed(x0,z0),power=s===side?1:.67;
       emit('ripple',{x:x0,z:z0,y:.13,bed,width:1.35*power,length:1.75*power,
         life:.75,alpha:.75,growth:1.9,color:0xd7f7ff});
       for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
         const spread=(i-1.5)*.32,speed=1.5+i*.23;
         emit('air',{x:x0+spread*fx,z:z0+spread*fz,y:surface+.12,bed,
           vx:rx*s*speed+fx*.55,vz:rz*s*speed+fz*.55,
           vy:(2.2+i*.29)*power,gravity:9,ground:surface+.03,
           width:.10+power*.045,life:.54,alpha:.9,growth:.28,color:0xd8f8ff});
         stats.droplets++;
       }
     }
     return true;
   }
   function boatTrail(v,speed,back,width){
     const s=Math.sin(v.hd),c=Math.cos(v.hd),turn=clamp(v.yawRate||0,-2,2),
       spread=width*(1+Math.min(.4,Math.abs(turn)*.2)),
       lifetime=1.8+Math.min(1.7,speed/22);
     for(const side of [-1,1]){
       const x=v.x+s*back+side*c*spread,z=v.z+c*back-side*s*spread;
       emit('wake',{x,z,y:.10,
         vx:s*speed*.07+side*c*(.65+speed*.025),
         vz:c*speed*.07-side*s*(.65+speed*.025),
         heading:v.hd,width:.6+width*.28+speed*.02,
         length:1.5+speed*.12,life:lifetime,
         alpha:.68,growth:1.6,bed:waterBed(x,z),
         color:side>0?0xc5eff2:0xe2f9fa});
     }
     if(speed>11){
       const x=v.x+s*back,z=v.z+c*back;
       emit('wake',{x,z,y:.10,vx:s*speed*.035,vz:c*speed*.035,
         heading:v.hd,width:width*.7+1,length:2.3+speed*.14,
         life:1.4,alpha:.52,growth:1.5,color:0xe8faf6});
     }
     stats.waterTrails++;
   }
   const landWidths={bici:.43,moto:.49,cotxe:1.08,camio:1.8,
     tanc:2.15,tanqueta:1.55};
   const waterWidths={barca_rems:.55,windsurf:.4,moto_aquatica:.65,
     llanxa:1.65,llanxa_coets:1.85,hover:1.45,ferry:4.4};
   const backs={barca_rems:1.5,windsurf:1.4,moto_aquatica:1.55,
     llanxa:3.3,llanxa_coets:3.7,hover:2.3,ferry:7.5,
     bici:1.1,moto:1.1,cotxe:2.05,camio:3.35,tanc:3.3,tanqueta:2.5};
   function landTrail(v,speed,back,ground,type=v.t){
     const s=Math.sin(v.hd),c=Math.cos(v.hd),width=landWidths[type]||1,
       bike=type==='bici',heavy=['tanc','tanqueta','camio'].includes(type),
       density=clamp((speed-3)/22,.16,.8)*(bike?.42:1);
     for(const side of [-1,1]){
       const x=v.x+s*back+side*c*width,z=v.z+c*back-side*s*width;
       emit('air',{x,z,y:ground+.22,
         vx:s*speed*.07+side*c*.52,vz:c*speed*.07-side*s*.52,
         vy:.25,life:heavy?1.75:1.32,
         width:.7+speed*.025+(heavy?.45:0),
         color:heavy?0xada296:0xc4b39b,alpha:density,growth:2.1});
     }
     // Escapament: mai a la bicicleta, més dens en camions i blindats.
     if(!bike){
       const x=v.x+s*back,z=v.z+c*back;
       emit('smoke',{x,z,y:ground+(heavy?1.65:.9),
         vx:s*speed*.11,vz:c*speed*.11,vy:.42,
         width:heavy?.7:.37,life:1.16+speed*.014,
         color:heavy?0x666660:0x94908a,alpha:heavy?.48:.3,growth:1.65});
     }
     stats.landTrails++;
   }
   function rotorDownwash(v,dt,terrain,waterY){
     const limit=v.t==='heli_combat'?15:13,
       height=v.alt-Math.max(terrain,waterY),
       intensity=clamp((limit-height)/limit,0,1);
     if(intensity<=.01)return;
     v.fxRotorAccum=(v.fxRotorAccum||0)+dt;
     const delay=(quality==='desktop'?.10:.16)/Math.max(.35,intensity);
     if(v.fxRotorAccum<delay)return;
     v.fxRotorAccum%=delay;
     const overSea=terrain<waterY-.3,count=quality==='ultra'?2:3;
     for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
       const angle=(i+rand()*.45)*Math.PI*2/count+v.hd,
         radius=2+rand()*3.4,
         x=v.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,z=v.z+Math.sin(angle)*radius,
         vx=Math.cos(angle)*(3+intensity*5),vz=Math.sin(angle)*(3+intensity*5);
       if(overSea){
         emit('wake',{x,z,y:.12,vx,vz,width:1.5+intensity*1.4,
           length:1.7+intensity*1.5,life:.95,alpha:intensity*.49,
           growth:1.7,color:0xe5f8ff});
       }else{
         emit('air',{x,z,y:terrain+.24,vx,vz,vy:.5+intensity*.5,
           life:1.1+intensity*.65,width:1.7+intensity*1.7,
           alpha:intensity*.36,color:0xb4a58d,growth:2.5});
       }
     }
     stats.downwash++;
   }
   function vehicle(v,dt,{playerX,playerZ,playerVehicle=null,terrainAt,waterAt,enemy=false}){
     if(v.destroyed||v.crashing||v.carrier)return;
     // Jeep i patrullera comparteixen el model visual del cotxe i la llanxa.
     const type=enemy?(v.t==='jeep'?'cotxe':
       v.t==='patrulla_marina'?'llanxa':v.t):v.t;
     const dx=v.x-playerX,dz=v.z-playerZ,
       range=enemy?settings.enemyRange:settings.range,
       near=dx*dx+dz*dz<range*range,
       prevX=v.fxPrevX,prevZ=v.fxPrevZ;
     // Sempre actualitzam la posició per evitar esteles gegants al
     // tornar a entrar dins la distància visible.
     v.fxPrevX=v.x;v.fxPrevZ=v.z;
     const distance=prevX==null?0:Math.hypot(v.x-prevX,v.z-prevZ),
       moved=distance<28?Math.min(distance,4):0,
       // Els hostils no exposen velocitat 'v': feim servir el seu
       // desplaçament real (així no hi ha fum si queden encallats).
       speed=enemy?(dt>.0001&&distance<28?distance/dt:0):Math.abs(v.v||0);
     if(!near){if(enemy)v.fxTrailDist=0;return}
     const terrain=terrainAt(v.x,v.z),water=waterAt(v.x,v.z),
       mode=window.HUNTER_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS.types[type]?.m;
     if(mode==='a'){
       if(v===playerVehicle||(enemy&&speed>.5))
         rotorDownwash(v,dt,terrain,water);
       return;
     }
     const watery=mode==='w'||(mode==='wl'&&water>terrain+.6);
     if(watery&&!waterVisible)return;
     if(speed<(watery?2.2:4)||moved<.04)return;
     const spacing=(watery?2.8:2.1)*settings.spacing;
     v.fxTrailDist=(v.fxTrailDist||0)+moved;
     if(v.fxTrailDist<spacing)return;
     v.fxTrailDist%=spacing;
     const back=(backs[type]||2)*(enemy||v.v>=0?1:-1);
     if(watery)boatTrail(v,speed,back,waterWidths[type]||1);
     else landTrail(v,speed,back,terrain,type);
   }
   function damageSmoke(v,damage,y){
     const dark=damage>.65?0x2b2b2c:0x696966,
       width=.35+damage*.55;
     for(let i=0;i<(damage>.65?2:1);i++)
       emit('smoke',{x:v.x+(rand()-.5)*.9,
         z:v.z+(rand()-.5)*.9,y:y+(rand()-.5)*.24,
         vx:(rand()-.5)*1.2,vz:(rand()-.5)*1.2,
         vy:1.1+damage*1.35,width,life:1.65+damage*.85,
         alpha:.46+damage*.29,growth:2.5,color:dark});
   }
   function update(dt,camera){
     if(camera)face.copy(camera.quaternion);
     let draws=0;
     for(const [kind,group] of Object.entries(groups)){
       const live=group.particles,alphas=group.alpha.array,
         colors=group.tint.array,beds=group.seabed.array;
       let count=0;
       for(let i=0;i<live.length;i++){
         const p=live[i];p.age+=dt;
         if(p.age>=p.life)continue;
         const progress=p.age/p.life;
         p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.z+=p.vz*dt;
         p.vy-=p.gravity*dt;
         if(p.gravity&&p.y<p.ground)continue;
         const size=1+p.growth*progress;
         dummy.position.set(p.x,p.y,p.z);
         if(group.flat)dummy.rotation.set(0,p.heading,0);
         else dummy.quaternion.copy(face);
         if(group.flat)dummy.scale.set(p.width*size,1,p.length*size);
         else dummy.scale.set(p.width*size,p.length*size,1);
         dummy.updateMatrix();
         group.mesh.setMatrixAt(count,dummy.matrix);
         alphas[count]=p.alpha*Math.pow(1-progress,1.25);
         colors[count*3]=p.cr;colors[count*3+1]=p.cg;colors[count*3+2]=p.cb;
         beds[count]=p.bed;live[count]=p;count++;
       }
       live.length=count;group.mesh.count=count;
       group.mesh.visible=count>0&&(waterVisible||!group.flat);
       stats.active[kind]=count;
       if(count){
         group.mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
         group.alpha.needsUpdate=true;group.tint.needsUpdate=true;
         group.seabed.needsUpdate=true;
         if(group.mesh.visible)draws++;
       }
     }
     stats.drawMeshes=draws;
   }
   function setWaterVisible(value){
     waterVisible=!!value;
     for(const kind of ['wake','ripple'])
       groups[kind].mesh.visible=waterVisible&&groups[kind].particles.length>0;
   }
   function reset(){
     previousFootBucket=null;previousSwimBucket=null;
     for(const [name,group] of Object.entries(groups)){
       group.particles.length=0;group.mesh.count=0;group.mesh.visible=false;
       stats.active[name]=0;
     }
     stats.drawMeshes=0;stats.resets++;
   }
   function dispose(){
     for(const group of Object.values(groups)){
       scene.remove(group.mesh);group.geometry.dispose();group.material.dispose();
     }
   }
   return{stats,groups,emit,footstep,playerStep,swimStroke,vehicle,damageSmoke,update,
     setWaterVisible,reset,dispose};
 }
});

;
// END src/movement-fx.js
// BEGIN src/air-obstacles.js
// Col·lisions 3D de l'antena i la parabòlica amb fuselatge i disc del rotor.
// Sense afegir malles de Three.js ni noves crides de dibuix.
(()=>{
  const registry=world=>world.userData.airObstacles||(world.userData.airObstacles=[]);
  function registerAntenna(world,root,spec,plinth){
    const scale=spec.scale||1;
    const entry={kind:'antenna',root,plinth,scale,
      height:Math.max(spec.height,31*scale)};
    registry(world).push(entry);return entry;
  }
  function registerSatellite(world,root,building,radius){
    const entry={kind:'satellite',root,building,radius};
    registry(world).push(entry);return entry;
  }
  const sq=x=>x*x;
  function antennaHit(T,e,x,z,skidY,topY,rotorY,rotorR,bodyR){
    const root=e.root,scale=e.scale,local=new T.Vector3(x,0,z);
    root.worldToLocal(local);
    const distance=Math.hypot(local.x,local.z),
      base=root.position.y,top=base+e.height,
      radiusAt=y=>{
        const localY=(y-base)/scale;
        if(localY<.9)return 4*scale*Math.SQRT2;
        if(localY>29)return .35*scale;
        return Math.max(.3,2.7-.065*localY)*scale*Math.SQRT2+.25;
      };
    // Rotor horitzontal: també pot colpejar la torre amb el fuselatge lluny.
    if(rotorY>=base-.35&&rotorY<=top+.35&&
       distance<=rotorR+radiusAt(rotorY)+.35)
      return {y:rotorY,part:'torre'};
    if(topY>=base&&skidY<=top){
      const hitY=Math.max(base,Math.min(top,(skidY+topY)/2));
      if(distance<=bodyR+radiusAt(hitY))
        return {y:hitY,part:'torre'};
    }
    // Plat petit que sobresurt al lateral de l'antena.
    const dish=new T.Vector3(0,18*scale,3*scale).applyMatrix4(root.matrixWorld),
      dishR=2.2*scale,
      horizontal=Math.hypot(x-dish.x,z-dish.z),
      dy=Math.abs(rotorY-dish.y);
    if(dy<=dishR+.3&&horizontal<=rotorR+
      Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,sq(dishR+.3)-sq(dy))))
      return {y:dish.y,part:'plat de l’antena'};
    const bodyY=Math.max(skidY,Math.min(topY,dish.y));
    if(sq(horizontal)+sq(bodyY-dish.y)<=sq(bodyR+dishR))
      return {y:dish.y,part:'plat de l’antena'};
    return null;
  }
  function satellitePoint(p,clearance,radius,rotation,T){
    // Sòcol, pedestal i braços, fixats al sostre.
    if(p.y>=-clearance-.2&&p.y<=6.2+clearance&&
       Math.hypot(p.x,p.z)<=3.5+clearance)return true;
    // Plat de 18 m orientat. Aproximació del paraboloide real:
    // z=2.7*(r/R)^2, amb reforços de gruix ~1.3 m.
    p.sub(new T.Vector3(0,6,0)).applyQuaternion(rotation);
    const r=Math.hypot(p.x,p.y),radialGap=Math.max(0,r-radius),
      surface=2.7*sq(Math.min(1,r/radius)),
      depthGap=Math.max(0,Math.abs(p.z-surface)-.65);
    if(sq(radialGap)+sq(depthGap)<=sq(clearance))return true;
    // Trípode i focus de l'extrem de la parabòlica.
    return r<=.48+clearance&&p.z>=5.6-clearance&&p.z<=7.9+clearance;
  }
  function satelliteHit(T,e,x,z,skidY,topY,rotorY,rotorR,bodyR){
    const inverse=new T.Matrix4().copy(e.root.matrixWorld).invert(),
      rotation=new T.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new T.Euler(-.62,.3,0)).invert(),
      local=(a,b,c)=>new T.Vector3(a,b,c).applyMatrix4(inverse);
    for(const y of [skidY+bodyR*.45,(skidY+topY)/2,topY-bodyR*.35]){
      if(satellitePoint(local(x,y,z),bodyR,e.radius,rotation,T))
        return {y,part:'parabòlica'};
    }
    // Rotor com a disc, amb el centre i dos anells de mostres.
    if(satellitePoint(local(x,rotorY,z),.38,e.radius,rotation,T))
      return {y:rotorY,part:'parabòlica'};
    for(const factor of [.52,1]){
      const r=rotorR*factor;
      for(let n=0;n<24;n++){
        const angle=n*Math.PI/12;
        if(satellitePoint(local(x+Math.cos(angle)*r,rotorY,
          z+Math.sin(angle)*r),.46,e.radius,rotation,T))
          return {y:rotorY,part:'parabòlica'};
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  function hit(T,world,v,start,end,modelScale=1){
    const obstacles=world?.userData?.airObstacles;
    if(!obstacles?.length||v.destroyed||v.crashing)return null;
    const skid=v.o?.userData?.skidContactHeight||0,
      rotor=v.o?.userData?.rotorContactHeight||
        (v.t==='heli_combat'?3.3:3.9)*modelScale,
      topHeight=(v.t==='heli_combat'?3:3.45)*modelScale,
      bodyR=(v.t==='heli_combat'?1.45:1.65)*modelScale,
      rotorR=(v.t==='heli_combat'?6.75:7.4)*modelScale,
      dx=end.x-start.x,dz=end.z-start.z,da=end.alt-start.alt,
      steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(dx,dz,da)/1.3));
    for(const e of obstacles){
      if(!e.root.parent)continue;
      if(e.kind==='antenna'&&e.plinth?.hp<=0)continue;
      if(e.kind==='satellite'&&(e.building?.rhp<=0||e.building?.rb))continue;
      e.root.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
      const center=e.root.getWorldPosition(new T.Vector3()),
        extent=e.kind==='antenna'?11:e.radius+9,
        mx=(start.x+end.x)/2,mz=(start.z+end.z)/2;
      if(Math.hypot(mx-center.x,mz-center.z)>
        extent+rotorR+Math.hypot(dx,dz)/2+3)continue;
      const lower=center.y-(e.kind==='satellite'?12:0),
        upper=center.y+(e.kind==='antenna'?e.height:20);
      if(Math.max(start.alt,end.alt)+rotor<lower-3||
         Math.min(start.alt,end.alt)+skid>upper+bodyR+3)continue;
      for(let k=0;k<=steps;k++){
        const t=k/steps,x=start.x+dx*t,z=start.z+dz*t,
          alt=start.alt+da*t,skidY=alt+skid,topY=alt+topHeight,
          rotorY=alt+rotor,
          struck=e.kind==='antenna'
            ?antennaHit(T,e,x,z,skidY,topY,rotorY,rotorR,bodyR)
            :satelliteHit(T,e,x,z,skidY,topY,rotorY,rotorR,bodyR);
        if(struck)return {kind:e.kind,part:struck.part,x,z,alt,y:struck.y,
          obstacle:e,t};
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  window.HUNTER_AIR_OBSTACLES=Object.freeze({registerAntenna,registerSatellite,hit});
})();

;
// END src/air-obstacles.js
// BEGIN src/joystick.js
// Joystick tàctil analògic amb una prolongació superior integrada per córrer.
window.HUNTER_JOYSTICK=Object.freeze({
  create(root,{deadzone=.1,response=1.15,maxTravel=.36}={}){
    const knob=root.querySelector('.joy-knob'),
          state={x:0,y:0,active:false,id:null,running:false};
    let runEnabled=false,lastPointer=null;
    const reset=()=>{
      state.x=state.y=0;state.active=false;state.id=null;state.running=false;
      lastPointer=null;root.classList.remove('running');
      knob.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%)';
    };
    const move=e=>{
      if(!state.active||e.pointerId!==state.id)return;
      lastPointer={pointerId:e.pointerId,clientX:e.clientX,clientY:e.clientY};
      const r=root.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=r.left+r.width/2,cy=r.top+r.height/2,
            max=r.width*maxTravel,rawX=e.clientX-cx,rawY=e.clientY-cy;
      // Només es corre cap endavant, en arrossegar dins la prolongació
      // situada FORA del perímetre superior del cercle del joystick.
      const running=runEnabled&&rawY< -r.height/2&&Math.abs(rawX)<=r.width*.29;
      state.running=running;root.classList.toggle('running',running);
      if(running){
        state.x=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,rawX/max))*.72;
        state.y=-1;
        // El pom puja visualment a la zona de cursa però continua
        // pertanyent al mateix joystick i al mateix pointer capturat.
        const knobX=Math.max(-12,Math.min(12,rawX*.25));
        knob.style.transform=`translate(calc(-50% + ${knobX}px),calc(-50% - ${r.height*.67}px))`;
        return;
      }
      let dx=rawX,dy=rawY;
      const distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      if(distance>max){dx*=max/distance;dy*=max/distance}
      let x=dx/max,y=dy/max;
      const mag=Math.hypot(x,y);
      if(mag<deadzone)x=y=0;
      else if(mag>0){
        const scaled=Math.pow((mag-deadzone)/(1-deadzone),response);
        x=x/mag*scaled;y=y/mag*scaled;
      }
      state.x=x;state.y=y;
      knob.style.transform=`translate(calc(-50% + ${dx}px),calc(-50% + ${dy}px))`;
    };
    const setRunEnabled=enabled=>{
      const next=!!enabled;
      if(runEnabled===next)return;
      runEnabled=next;root.classList.toggle('run-enabled',next);
      if(state.active&&lastPointer)move(lastPointer);
      else state.running=false;
    };
    root.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
      if(state.active)return;
      e.preventDefault();state.active=true;state.id=e.pointerId;
      root.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);move(e);
    });
    root.addEventListener('pointermove',move);
    for(const type of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])
      root.addEventListener(type,e=>{if(state.active&&e.pointerId===state.id)reset()});
    return {state,reset,setRunEnabled};
  }
});

;
// END src/joystick.js

// Model tàctic aprovat: base compartida pel jugador, els conductors i els enemics.

// La proposta D només s'aplica quan es demana explícitament: no canvia soldats ni general.
const HUNTER_COMPACT_HEAD_D=Object.freeze({
  headScale:Object.freeze([.74,.74,.71]),
  neckScale:Object.freeze([.75,.66,.75]),
  headY:3.26,visorDepth:.94,visorTilt:.05,capY:-.03

window.HUNTER_PLAYER_MODEL=Object.freeze({
 headStyles:Object.freeze({compactD:HUNTER_COMPACT_HEAD_D}),
 create(T,{unitScale=1,palette=window.HUNTER_PALETTE,headVariant=null,articulated=false}={}){
 
 const p={chest:1.04,waist:.76,head:.44,arm:.27,leg:.35,pack:.66};
 const g=new T.Group(),u=g.userData;u.boots=[];
 const colors={green:0x3ee43a,lime:0x72f05a,dark:0x18271e,olive:0x46602d,skin:0xf0c9a0,black:0x162021};
 const mats=new Map(),mat=(c)=>{if(!mats.has(c))mats.set(c,new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:.9,metalness:0,flatShading:true}));return mats.get(c)};
 function mesh(parent,geo,c,x=0,y=0,z=0){const m=new T.Mesh(geo,mat(c));m.position.set(x,y,z);m.castShadow=m.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m}
 const box=(pa,w,h,d,c,x,y,z)=>mesh(pa,new T.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),c,x,y,z);
 const oval=(pa,xr,yr,zr,c,x,y,z,seg=10)=>{const m=mesh(pa,new T.SphereGeometry(1,seg,6),c,x,y,z);m.scale.set(xr,yr,zr);return m};
 const segment=(pa,top,bottom,h,depth,c,x,y,z)=>{const m=mesh(pa,new T.CylinderGeometry(top,bottom,h,8),c,x,y,z);m.scale.z=depth;return m};
 function torsoShape(width,waist,h,depth,c,y){
  const a=width/2,b=waist/2,d=depth/2,k=.15;
  const ring=w=>[[-w+k,-d], [w-k,-d],[w,-d+k],[w,d-k],[w-k,d],[-w+k,d],[-w,d-k],[-w,-d+k]];
  const lo=ring(b),hi=ring(a),pts=[],indices=[];
  for(const [x,z]of lo)pts.push(x,-h/2,z);for(const[x,z]of hi)pts.push(x,h/2,z);
  for(let j=0;j<8;j++){const n=(j+1)%8;indices.push(j,n,n+8,j,n+8,j+8)}for(let j=1;j<7;j++){indices.push(0,j+1,j,8,8+j,8+j+1)}
  const geo=new T.BufferGeometry();geo.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(pts,3));geo.setIndex(indices.reverse());geo.computeVertexNormals();return mesh(g,geo,c,0,y,0);
 }
 // Cames articulades; peu a y=0 i maluc a 1.72.
 for(const side of[-1,1]){
  const hip=new T.Group();hip.position.set(side*.265,1.73,0);g.add(hip);
  segment(hip,p.leg*.58,p.leg*.48,.77,1.12,colors.green,0,-.37,0);
  const knee=new T.Group();knee.position.y=-.75;hip.add(knee);
  segment(knee,p.leg*.49,p.leg*.4,.68,1.12,colors.green,0,-.33,0);
  box(knee,p.leg*.91,.28,.13,colors.olive,0,-.02,-p.leg*.55);
  // Anatomical boot: narrow ankle, sloped instep, rounded toe and separate heel.
  const boot=new T.Group();knee.add(boot);u.boots.push(boot);
  const bootColor=0x202d28;
  segment(boot,.14,.16,.31,1.1,bootColor,0,-.68,.025);
  const outline=[[-.13,.16],[.13,.16],[.17,.02],[.18,-.27],[.12,-.36],[-.12,-.36],[-.18,-.27],[-.17,.02]];
  const points=[],idx=[];
  for(const level of[0,1])for(const[x,z]of outline){points.push(x,level?(-.77+(z>.0?.075:0)):-.89,z)}
  for(let j=0;j<8;j++){let n=(j+1)%8;idx.push(j,n,n+8,j,n+8,j+8)}
  for(let j=1;j<7;j++){idx.push(0,j+1,j,8,8+j,8+j+1)}
  const bg=new T.BufferGeometry();bg.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(points,3));bg.setIndex(idx);bg.computeVertexNormals();
  // Outline is clockwise when viewed from above: these faces point outward.
  mesh(boot,bg,bootColor);
  const soleShape=new T.Shape();outline.forEach(([x,z],j)=>j?soleShape.lineTo(x,-z):soleShape.moveTo(x,-z));soleShape.closePath();
  const sole=mesh(boot,new T.ExtrudeGeometry(soleShape,{depth:.045,bevelEnabled:false}),0x121b17,0,-.92,0);sole.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
  box(boot,.25,.055,.16,0x111914,0,-.925,.075);
  for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const lace=box(boot,.16,.018,.024,0x87856d,0,-.74-j*.021,-.035-j*.055);lace.rotation.x=.3}
  boot.children.forEach(o=>o.position.y+=.82);boot.position.y=-.82;
  oval(knee,p.leg*.44,.13,p.leg*.46,colors.green,0,0,0,8);
  u[side<0?'ll':'lr']=hip;u[side<0?'lkl':'lkr']=knee;
 }
 torsoShape(p.chest,p.waist,1.23,.61,colors.green,2.31);
 const waistBelt=box(g,p.waist+.08,.15,.65,colors.dark,0,1.77,0),waistBuckle=box(g,.19,.13,.055,0xb1b48a,0,1.78,-.355);
  torsoShape(p.chest+.05,p.waist+.06,.94,.76,0x314d27,2.35);
  for(const x of[-.30,0,.30]){
   box(g,.25,.34,.14,0x395333,x,2.12,-.44);
   box(g,.26,.055,.155,colors.olive,x,2.29,-.445);
  }
  for(const y of[2.46,2.55])box(g,.70,.035,.04,0x708854,0,y,-.405);
  for(const x of[-.34,.34])box(g,.18,.25,.16,colors.olive,x,2.87,-.26);
  box(g,.26,.12,.025,colors.lime,.24,2.66,-.405);

 // Motxilla diferenciada i tirants (vista posterior també renderitzada).
 {box(g,p.pack,1.02,.38,colors.olive,0,2.31,.48);box(g,p.pack*.86,.32,.12,0x607b38,0,2.11,.72);box(g,p.pack+.02,.16,.41,0x607b38,0,2.87,.49)}
 for(const x of[-.3,.3])box(g,.1,1.1,.09,colors.dark,x,2.33,.35);
 // Braços amb espatlla i colze; postura neutra comuna.
 for(const side of[-1,1]){
  const shoulder=new T.Group();shoulder.position.set(side*.57,2.90,0);shoulder.rotation.z=side*.12;g.add(shoulder);
  oval(shoulder,p.arm*.65,.22,p.arm*.65,colors.lime,0,-.11,0,8);
  segment(shoulder,p.arm*.57,p.arm*.49,.567,1,colors.green,0,-.336,0);
  const elbow=new T.Group();elbow.position.y=-.63;elbow.rotation.x=-.08;elbow.rotation.z=side*.04;shoulder.add(elbow);
  segment(elbow,p.arm*.49,p.arm*.38,.525,1,colors.green,0,-.252,0);
  oval(elbow,.13,.16,.135,colors.dark,0,-.62,-.025,8);
  oval(elbow,p.arm*.45,.115,p.arm*.46,colors.green,0,0,0,8);
  oval(elbow,.12,.14,.05,colors.olive,0,.01,.12,8);
  u[side<0?'al':'ar']=shoulder;u[side<0?'ael':'aer']=elbow;
 }
 const neck=segment(g,.16,.18,.28,1,colors.skin,0,3.02,0);
 const head=new T.Group();head.position.set(0,3.38,0);g.add(head);u.head=head;
 oval(head,p.head*.78,p.head,p.head*.77,colors.skin,0,0,0,12);
 // Petit nas, orelles, clatell: silhouettes lisibles sense textures.
 oval(head,.075,.085,.10,colors.skin,0,-.03,-p.head*.77,8);
 for(const side of[-1,1])oval(head,.07,.12,.065,colors.skin,side*p.head*.78,-.015,.02,8);
 // Hair follows the skull below the cap, with an irregular tapered edge and exposed ears.
 const hairColor=0x63432b;
 const hp=[],hi=[],n=18;
 for(let r=0;r<3;r++)for(let j=0;j<=n;j++){
  const angle=-1.52+j/n*3.04;
  const edge=-.09 + .045*Math.cos(angle*3+3) + (Math.abs(angle)>1.18?.095:0);
  const y=r===0?.30:r===1?.12:edge;
  const rad=Math.sqrt(Math.max(.01,1-(y/.45)**2));
  hp.push(Math.sin(angle)*.356*rad,y,Math.cos(angle)*.35*rad+.012);
 }
 for(let r=0;r<2;r++)for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const a=r*(n+1)+j,b=a+n+1;hi.push(a,b,a+1,a+1,b,b+1)}
 const hg=new T.BufferGeometry();hg.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(hp,3));hg.setIndex(hi);hg.computeVertexNormals();mesh(head,hg,hairColor);
 for(const side of[-1,1]){
  oval(head,.036,.105,.066,hairColor,side*.333,.105,-.024,8);
 }
 // Close-fitting cap; the edge hugs the skull and covers the hair roots.
 const capSettings={y:.195,r:.334,h:.265,length:.40,drop:.035};
 const c=capSettings;
 const cap=mesh(head,new T.SphereGeometry(1,16,7,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI/2),colors.green,0,c.y,0);cap.scale.set(c.r,c.h,c.r*.99);
 // A rounded, slightly downturned bill, rather than a rectangular slab.
 const vp=[],vi=[],steps=12;
 for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
  const t=-Math.PI/2+j/steps*Math.PI,x=Math.sin(t)*.305,z=-.205-Math.cos(t)*c.length;
  const drop=c.drop*Math.cos(t);
  vp.push(x,c.y-.014,-.16,x,c.y-.014-drop,z,x,c.y-.047-drop,z,x,c.y-.047,-.16);
 }
 for(let j=0;j<steps;j++)for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const a=j*4+k,b=(j+1)*4+k,n=(k+1)%4;vi.push(a,b,j*4+n,b,(j+1)*4+n,j*4+n)}
 const vg=new T.BufferGeometry();vg.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(vp,3));vg.setIndex(vi);vg.computeVertexNormals();const bill=mesh(head,vg,colors.green);u.visor=bill;u.cap=cap;bill.material=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:colors.green,roughness:.9,flatShading:true,side:T.DoubleSide});
 for(const side of[-1,1]){box(head,p.head*.61,.14,.06,colors.black,side*p.head*.37,.065,-p.head*.73);box(head,.04,.045,.28,colors.black,side*p.head*.72,.09,-p.head*.45)}
 box(head,.09,.045,.06,colors.black,0,.08,-p.head*.8);
 {box(head,.085,.2,.1,colors.black,.4,-.03,.02);box(head,.04,.04,.22,colors.black,.35,-.16,-.1)}
 // La variant D modifica només les proporcions locals del coll i del cap.
 // El rig del cos i les posicions d'espatlles, mans, genolls i malucs es mantenen.
 if(headVariant==='compactD'){
  const style=HUNTER_COMPACT_HEAD_D;
  head.scale.set(...style.headScale);
  head.position.y=style.headY;
  neck.scale.set(...style.neckScale);
  bill.scale.z=style.visorDepth;
  bill.rotation.x=style.visorTilt;
  cap.position.y+=style.capY;
 }else if(headVariant!=null){
  throw new RangeError('Variant de cap desconeguda: '+headVariant);
 }
 // Bake the requested unit size into geometry and pivots, keeping animation rotations intact.
 g.traverse(o=>{if(o!==g)o.position.multiplyScalar(unitScale);if(o.isMesh)o.geometry.scale(unitScale,unitScale,unitScale)});
 u.mats=[];
 const swaps=new Map([[colors.green,palette.enemy.primary],[colors.lime,palette.enemy.general],
  [0x314d27,palette.enemy.vest],[0x395333,palette.enemy.secondary],[colors.olive,palette.enemy.vest],
  [0x607b38,palette.enemy.secondary],[0x708854,palette.enemy.secondary]]);
 for(const [color,m]of mats)if(swaps.has(color))u.mats.push([m,color,swaps.get(color)]);
 u.mats.push([bill.material,colors.green,palette.enemy.primary]);
 u.headVariant=headVariant||'original';u.neck=neck;
 u.profile='tactic-approved-long-visor';u.forwardAxis='-Z';u.kneeFlexionSign=-1;
 u.hipHeight=1.73*unitScale;
 if(articulated){
  // Únicament el jugador a peu necessita articulació independent.
  // Els riders i els enemics conserven la jerarquia original.
  const lowerBody=new T.Group(),upperBody=new T.Group();
  lowerBody.name='hunter-pelvis-and-legs';upperBody.name='hunter-upper-torso';
  lowerBody.position.y=u.hipHeight;
  upperBody.position.y=1.84*unitScale; // pivot sobre la cintura
  const lowerParts=new Set([u.ll,u.lr,waistBelt,waistBuckle]);
  for(const part of [...g.children]){
    const pivot=lowerParts.has(part)?lowerBody:upperBody;
    // Reparentar sense alterar les posicions de repòs globals del model.
    part.position.y-=pivot.position.y;
    pivot.add(part);
  }
  g.add(lowerBody,upperBody);
  u.lowerBody=lowerBody;u.upperBody=upperBody;
  u.upperBodyPivotHeight=upperBody.position.y;
 }
 return g;
 }
});

;
// END src/player-model.js
// BEGIN src/bolt-cutters.js
// Cisalla articulada compartida pel personatge i l'objecte del món.
window.HUNTER_BOLT_CUTTERS=Object.freeze({
 create(T){
  const root=new T.Group();root.name='hunter-bolt-cutters';
  const red=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xb83f38,roughness:.84}),
    steel=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x98a8ac,roughness:.38,metalness:.68}),
    edge=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd2dcdf,roughness:.29,metalness:.78}),
    dark=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x374247,roughness:.52,metalness:.43});
  const arms=[];
  for(const sign of [-1,1]){
   const arm=new T.Group();root.add(arm);arms.push(arm);
   const rod=(h,r,x,y,mat,angle=0)=>{
    const mesh=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(r*.9,r,h,7),mat);
    mesh.position.set(x,y,0);mesh.rotation.z=angle;arm.add(mesh);
   };
   rod(1.20,.105,sign*.17,-.68,red,sign*.12);
   rod(.55,.068,sign*.074,.18,steel,-sign*.22);
   const blade=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(.09,.41,.15),edge);
   blade.position.set(sign*.029,.55,-.02);blade.rotation.z=-sign*.16;arm.add(blade);
   rod(.15,.13,sign*.15,-.21,dark);
   arm.rotation.z=sign*.16;
  }
  for(const [z,r,mat] of [[0,.145,dark],[.11,.062,steel]]){
   const pivot=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(r,r,.20,10),mat);
   pivot.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;pivot.position.set(0,-.025,z);root.add(pivot);
  }
  root.userData.bladeArms=arms;return root;
 },
 pose(root,closing=0){
  if(!root?.userData?.bladeArms)return;
  const k=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,closing));
  root.userData.bladeArms.forEach((a,i)=>{a.rotation.z=(i?1:-1)*(.16-.24*k)});
 }
});
;
// END src/bolt-cutters.js
// BEGIN src/rider.js
// Pilot visual per vehicles oberts. La física del vehicle continua al nucli.
window.HUNTER_RIDER=Object.freeze({
  create(THREE,{scene,box,material,scales,heightAt,shadows}){
    const g=new THREE.Group(),torso=new THREE.Group();g.add(torso);
    // El rider és el mateix protagonista: fa servir el cap D i el coll curt,
    // sense canviar cap seient, escala del vehicle ni pivot de les extremitats.
    const model=window.HUNTER_PLAYER_MODEL.create(THREE,{headVariant:'compactD'}),rig=model.userData;
    const limbs=[],boots=rig.boots;
    for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
      const shoulder=i?rig.ar:rig.al,elbow=i?rig.aer:rig.ael;
      const hip=i?rig.lr:rig.ll,knee=i?rig.lkr:rig.lkl;
      for(const [part,len,slot]of[[shoulder,.63,i*2],[elbow,.62,i*2+1],[hip,.75,4+i*2],[knee,.82,5+i*2]]){
        g.add(part);part.userData.restLength=len;part.rotation.set(0,0,0);limbs[slot]=part;
      }
      g.add(boots[i]);
    }
    // The torso origin is the seat/hip, as expected by the existing vehicle poses.
    for(const part of [...model.children]){part.position.y-=rig.hipHeight;torso.add(part)}
    // Pistola visual pròpia del rider; no reempram la del model ocult a peu.
    // Mateixa geometria i retrocés que l'arma de la resta del joc.
    const pistol=new THREE.Group();pistol.scale.setScalar(.92);g.add(pistol);
    const pistolParts=createPlayerPistol(THREE,pistol);
    pistol.visible=false;
    g.userData={torso,limbs,boots,head:rig.head,neck:rig.neck,headVariant:rig.headVariant,
      mats:rig.mats,profile:rig.profile,motion:0,shotTime:0,shotAge:10,shotBlend:0,
      pistol,pistolParts,pistolAim:null};
    g.visible=false;g.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh)o.castShadow=shadows});scene.add(g);
    const down=new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0),delta=new THREE.Vector3();
    const limbBetween=(m,a,b)=>{
      delta.copy(b).sub(a);const length=delta.length();m.position.copy(a);
      m.scale.y=length/m.userData.restLength;
      if(length>1e-6)m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(down,delta.multiplyScalar(1/length));
    };
    const vec=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
    const shoulderAt=side=>vec(side*.57,1.17,0).applyQuaternion(torso.quaternion).add(torso.position);
    const muzzleLocal=new THREE.Vector3(0,.183,-.84),
          forward=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1);
    // Animació superposada després de la postura de conducció: la mà
    // esquerra continua al manillar, rem o botavara; la dreta apunta.
    const aimOneHand=(v,dt)=>{
      const u=g.userData;
      u.shotTime=Math.max(0,u.shotTime-dt);
      u.shotAge=Math.min(10,u.shotAge+dt);
      const active=u.shotTime>0;
      // Transicions suaus: el tret ja no força un gir instantani del tronc.
      u.shotBlend+=(Number(active)-u.shotBlend)*(1-Math.exp(-(active?8:9)*dt));
      if(!active&&u.shotBlend<.01){
        pistol.visible=false;pistolParts.flash.visible=false;return;
      }
      pistol.visible=true;
      const sc=v.t==='llanxa'?1.3:v.t==='llanxa_coets'?1.35:scales[v.t],
            rowing=v.t==='barca_rems',
            twist=v.t==='windsurf'?.055:.24;
      // A la barca l'arma s'ha de veure a escala amb el remador.
      pistol.scale.setScalar(rowing?.56:.92);
      if(rowing){
        // El remador només gira un poc les espatlles (uns 30°),
        // sense retorçar el tronc ni passar de cop al perfil.
        torso.rotation.y=Math.PI-.52*u.shotBlend;
      }else torso.rotation.y+=twist*u.shotBlend;
      const shoulder=shoulderAt(1),
            forearm=limbs[3],
            restingHand=new THREE.Vector3(0,-forearm.userData.restLength*forearm.scale.y,0)
              .applyQuaternion(forearm.quaternion).add(forearm.position),
            // El braç dret surt del rem amb una extensió curta cap a proa.
            // Evitam que travessi el pit o arribi a l'altre costat del buc.
            reach=rowing?vec(-.08*sc,-.26,-.48*sc):
              v.t==='windsurf'?vec(.17*sc,-.14,-1.02*sc):
              vec(.25*sc,-.29,-1.13*sc);
      const target=shoulder.clone().add(reach),
            hand=restingHand.lerp(target,u.shotBlend),
            elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.57);
      elbow.y-=.12;elbow.x+=rowing?-.05*sc:.12*sc;
      limbBetween(limbs[2],shoulder,elbow);limbBetween(limbs[3],elbow,hand);
      // La mà esquerra solta el rem durant el gir de cintura i
      // acompanya el tronc, sense estirar el braç a l'altre costat.
      if(rowing&&u.shotBlend>.001){
        const leftShoulder=shoulderAt(-1),
              relax=vec(-.22*sc,-.70,-.24*sc).applyQuaternion(torso.quaternion),
              leftHand=leftShoulder.clone().add(relax),
              leftElbow=leftShoulder.clone().lerp(leftHand,.53);
        leftElbow.y-=.12;
        const oldHand=vec(0,-limbs[1].userData.restLength*limbs[1].scale.y,0)
          .applyQuaternion(limbs[1].quaternion).add(limbs[1].position);
        const oldElbow=limbs[1].position.clone();
        // La mà esquerra continua pràcticament sobre el rem.
        oldHand.lerp(leftHand,u.shotBlend*.2);oldElbow.lerp(leftElbow,u.shotBlend*.2);
        limbBetween(limbs[0],leftShoulder,oldElbow);
        limbBetween(limbs[1],oldElbow,oldHand);
      }
      const recoil=Math.exp(-u.shotAge*18)*(rowing ? .045 : .095);
      pistol.position.copy(hand).add(vec(0,0,recoil));
      // La pistola apunta a proa (-Z) quan el remador s'hi gira.
      pistol.quaternion.identity();
      if(u.pistolAim)pistol.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(forward,u.pistolAim);
      pistolParts.slide.position.z=recoil*.65;
      pistolParts.flash.visible=u.shotAge<.055;
    };
    // Retorna el tret des de la boca REAL de la pistola, i orienta
    // l'arma segons l'autoapuntat del sistema existent.
    const firePistol=(v,autoAim)=>{
      if(!v||!g.visible)return null;
      const u=g.userData;u.shotTime=v.t==='barca_rems' ? .52 : .34;u.shotAge=0;
      // No forçam shotBlend: l'animació del remador s'interpola en update().
      if(v.t!=='barca_rems')u.shotBlend=Math.max(u.shotBlend,.82);
      u.pistolAim=null;
      aimOneHand(v,0);
      g.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);
      let origin=pistol.localToWorld(muzzleLocal.clone());
      const initial=forward.clone().applyQuaternion(pistol.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion()));
      const desired=autoAim(origin,initial);
      if(desired){
        const direction=new THREE.Vector3(...desired).normalize(),
              localDirection=direction.clone()
                .applyQuaternion(g.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion()).invert());
        u.pistolAim=localDirection;
        pistol.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(forward,localDirection);
        g.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);
        origin=pistol.localToWorld(muzzleLocal.clone());
      }
      return {origin,direction:forward.clone().applyQuaternion(
        pistol.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion())).normalize()};
    };
    const update=(v,dt)=>{
      const car=!!v&&(v.t==='cotxe_civil'||v.t==='cotxe');
      const open=!!v&&(car||['bici','moto','moto_aquatica','llanxa','llanxa_coets','barca_rems','windsurf'].includes(v.t));g.visible=open;
      if(!open){g.userData.shotTime=0;g.userData.shotBlend=0;g.userData.pistolAim=null;pistol.visible=false;g.scale.setScalar(1);return}
      const u=g.userData,sc=v.t==='llanxa'?1.3:v.t==='llanxa_coets'?1.35:scales[v.t],moving=Math.min(1,Math.abs(v.v)/1.8);u.motion+=(moving-u.motion)*(1-Math.exp(-12*dt));const motion=u.motion,phase=(v.t==='bici'||v.t==='barca_rems')?-(v.pedalPhase||0):(v.pedalPhase||0);
      // En cotxes l'habitacle és més baix que el protagonista dret.
      // Escalam el mateix model de jugador i preservam l'orientació
      // tridimensional del xassís en girs i pendents.
      const riderScale=car?.82:1;
      g.scale.setScalar(riderScale);
      g.position.copy(v.o.position);g.quaternion.copy(v.o.quaternion);torso.rotation.set(0,0,0);boots.forEach(b=>b.rotation.set(0,0,0));

      if(car){
        // Seient esquerre, darrere del volant (C1A i cotxe utilitari).
        // Posicions físiques convertides al sistema del rider escalat.
        const civil=v.t==='cotxe_civil',
              humvee=!civil&&v.o?.userData?.humveeModel==='D3.1',
              // The Humvee cabin is forward-facing -Z and wider than the
              // previous military car. Rider and wheel now share this seat.
              seatX=(civil?-.613:humvee?-.84:-.72)*sc,
              seatY=(civil?1.14:humvee?1.24:1.22)*sc,
              seatZ=(civil?-.60:humvee?-.26:.42)*sc,
              steeringX=seatX,
              steeringY=(civil?1.66:humvee?1.60:1.91)*sc,
              steeringZ=(civil?-.94:humvee?-.87:-.67)*sc,
              invScale=1/riderScale;
        torso.position.set(seatX*invScale,seatY*invScale,seatZ*invScale);
        torso.rotation.x=-.05;
        for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
          const side=i?1:-1,
                shoulder=shoulderAt(side),
                hip=vec((seatX+side*.20*sc)*invScale,
                  seatY*invScale,seatZ*invScale),
                hand=vec((steeringX+side*.22*sc)*invScale,
                  steeringY*invScale,steeringZ*invScale),
                elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.50),
                foot=vec((seatX+side*.20*sc)*invScale,
                  .87*sc*invScale,(civil?-1.31:humvee?-1.10:-.95)*sc*invScale),
                knee=hip.clone().lerp(foot,.52);
          elbow.y-=.10*sc*invScale;
          knee.y+=.08*sc*invScale;knee.z+=.11*sc*invScale;
          limbBetween(limbs[i*2],shoulder,elbow);
          limbBetween(limbs[i*2+1],elbow,hand);
          limbBetween(limbs[4+i*2],hip,knee);
          limbBetween(limbs[5+i*2],knee,foot);
          boots[i].position.copy(foot);
          boots[i].rotation.x=-.2;
        }
        pistol.visible=false;
        return;
      }

      if(v.t==='bici'||v.t==='moto'){
        const seat=1.65*sc;torso.position.set(0,seat,.4*sc);torso.rotation.x=.15*motion;
        for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const side=i?1:-1,hip=vec(side*.28,seat,.4*sc),shoulder=shoulderAt(side),hand=vec(side*.5*sc,1.96*sc,-sc),elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.52);elbow.x+=side*.1;elbow.y-=.2;limbBetween(limbs[i*2],shoulder,elbow);limbBetween(limbs[i*2+1],elbow,hand);
          const foot=vec(side*.55,0,.45*sc),worldFoot=foot.clone().applyQuaternion(g.quaternion).add(g.position);worldFoot.y=heightAt(worldFoot.x,worldFoot.z)+.14;const groundFoot=worldFoot.sub(g.position).applyQuaternion(g.quaternion.clone().invert());const pedal=v.t==='bici'?vec(side*.4*sc,(.75-side*Math.sin(phase)*.28)*sc,side*Math.cos(phase)*.28*sc):vec(side*.5*sc,.72*sc,.1*sc);foot.copy(groundFoot).lerp(pedal,motion);const knee=hip.clone().lerp(foot,.5);knee.z-=.5*motion;knee.x+=side*.12*(1-motion);limbBetween(limbs[4+i*2],hip,knee);limbBetween(limbs[5+i*2],knee,foot);boots[i].position.copy(foot);boots[i].rotation.x=0}
        aimOneHand(v,dt);return;
      }

      if(v.t==='moto_aquatica'){
        const seat=.98*sc,lean=.18+.12*motion;torso.position.set(0,seat,.3*sc);torso.rotation.x=lean;
        for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const side=i?1:-1,hip=vec(side*.25,seat,.3*sc),shoulder=shoulderAt(side),hand=vec(side*.38*sc,1.32*sc,-.58*sc),elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.55);elbow.y-=.12;limbBetween(limbs[i*2],shoulder,elbow);limbBetween(limbs[i*2+1],elbow,hand);
          const foot=vec(side*.38*sc,.48*sc,.58*sc),knee=hip.clone().lerp(foot,.5);knee.z-=.25;limbBetween(limbs[4+i*2],hip,knee);limbBetween(limbs[5+i*2],knee,foot);boots[i].position.copy(foot);boots[i].rotation.x=.15}
        aimOneHand(v,dt);return;
      }

      if(v.t==='barca_rems'){
        const seat=v.o.userData.rowingSeat,seatY=seat.y*sc,seatZ=seat.z*sc;
        const pull=(1-Math.cos(phase))*.5;
        torso.position.set(0,seatY,seatZ);torso.rotation.set(-.06+.15*pull*motion,Math.PI,0);
        v.o.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);g.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
        for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
          const side=i?1:-1,boatSide=-side,
                hip=vec(boatSide*.27,seatY,seatZ),
                // Quan el remador mira a popa la seva dreta anatòmica
                // és babord (-X). Cada mà agafa el rem del seu costat:
                // el braç dret = limbs[2,3] = rem de babord (índex 0).
                shoulder=shoulderAt(side);
          const oar=v.o.userData.oars[1-i],
                hand=g.worldToLocal(oar.localToWorld(oar.userData.grip.clone()));
          const elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.5);
          elbow.x+=boatSide*.18;elbow.y-=.13;
          limbBetween(limbs[i*2],shoulder,elbow);
          limbBetween(limbs[i*2+1],elbow,hand);
          const foot=vec(boatSide*.34,.2*sc,seatZ+.97*sc),
                knee=vec(boatSide*.32,seatY-.05,seatZ+.52*sc);
          limbBetween(limbs[4+i*2],hip,knee);
          limbBetween(limbs[5+i*2],knee,foot);
          boots[i].position.copy(foot);boots[i].rotation.set(0,Math.PI,0);
        }
        aimOneHand(v,dt);return;
      }

      if(v.t==='windsurf'){
        // 7/8 mirrored relative to the old silhouette: surfer stands on
        // starboard (+X) and faces across the board toward the mirrored
        // sail on port (-X), with hips back and slightly bent knees.
        // The rig pitches toward the bow; both hands follow actual points
        // on the moving boom, not hand positions guessed in rider space.
        const bodyX=.42*sc,hipY=1.38*sc,footY=.35*sc,
              sail=v.o.userData.windsurfRig,
              grips=v.o.userData.windsurfGrips||[],
              lean=.17+Math.min(.07,Math.abs(v.v)/230);
        torso.position.set(bodyX,hipY,.29*sc);
        torso.rotation.set(lean,1.13,.08);
        const hips=[vec(bodyX-.05*sc,hipY,.04*sc),
                    vec(bodyX+.08*sc,hipY,.46*sc)];
        // Crucial: anatomically correct shoulder index.
        // i=0 -> left arm, i=1 -> right arm (firing arm).
        v.o.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);
        g.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
        const hands=grips.map(p=>g.worldToLocal(
          (sail||v.o).localToWorld(p.clone())));
        const feet=[vec(.66*sc,footY,.99*sc),
                    vec(.72*sc,footY,-.63*sc)];
        for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
          const shoulder=shoulderAt(i?1:-1),hip=hips[i],
                hand=hands[i]||vec(-.5*sc,2.6*sc,.5*sc),
                foot=feet[i],
                elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.47),
                knee=hip.clone().lerp(foot,.51);
          // Bend the elbows down slightly, without forcing an
          // impossible knee/elbow pose away from the true grip.
          elbow.y-=.17*sc;
          elbow.z+=i?.08*sc:-.055*sc;
          limbBetween(limbs[i*2],shoulder,elbow);
          limbBetween(limbs[i*2+1],elbow,hand);
          knee.y+=.13*sc;knee.x-=.10*sc;
          limbBetween(limbs[4+i*2],hip,knee);
          limbBetween(limbs[5+i*2],knee,foot);
          boots[i].position.copy(foot);
          boots[i].rotation.set(-.12,1.13,0);
        }
        // Right hand releases only during the pistol animation; the
        // left hand stays planted on the rig and the torso barely twists.
        aimOneHand(v,dt);return;
      }

      if(v.t==='llanxa'||v.t==='llanxa_coets'){
        // Les dues llanxes comparteixen ara la mateixa escala gran del casc,
        // però cada rider conserva la mida que tenia abans del redisseny.
        const riderSc=v.t==='llanxa'?1.3:1.35,
              boatSc=scales[v.t]||1.95,
              offY=1.45*(boatSc-riderSc),offZ=.55*(boatSc-riderSc),
              seat=1.45*riderSc+offY,seatZ=.55*riderSc+offZ;
        torso.position.set(0,seat,seatZ);torso.rotation.x=.04;
        for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
          const side=i?1:-1,
                hip=vec(side*.28,seat,seatZ),
                shoulder=shoulderAt(side),
                hand=vec(side*.48*riderSc,seat+.7,-.7*riderSc+offZ),
                elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.52);
          limbBetween(limbs[i*2],shoulder,elbow);limbBetween(limbs[i*2+1],elbow,hand);
          const foot=vec(side*.42*riderSc,.92*riderSc+offY,-.35*riderSc+offZ),
                knee=hip.clone().lerp(foot,.5);knee.y+=.18;
          limbBetween(limbs[4+i*2],hip,knee);limbBetween(limbs[5+i*2],knee,foot);boots[i].position.copy(foot)
        }
        aimOneHand(v,dt);return;
      }

      const seat=1.45*sc;torso.position.set(0,seat,.55*sc);torso.rotation.x=.04;
      for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const side=i?1:-1,hip=vec(side*.28,seat,.55*sc),shoulder=shoulderAt(side),hand=vec(side*.48*sc,seat+.7,-.7*sc),elbow=shoulder.clone().lerp(hand,.52);limbBetween(limbs[i*2],shoulder,elbow);limbBetween(limbs[i*2+1],elbow,hand);
        const foot=vec(side*.42*sc,.92*sc,-.35*sc),knee=hip.clone().lerp(foot,.5);knee.y+=.18;limbBetween(limbs[4+i*2],hip,knee);limbBetween(limbs[5+i*2],knee,foot);boots[i].position.copy(foot)}
      aimOneHand(v,dt);
    };
    const reset=()=>{g.visible=false;g.userData.motion=0;g.userData.shotTime=0;
      g.userData.shotBlend=0;g.userData.pistolAim=null;pistol.visible=false};
    return {object:g,update,reset,firePistol};
  }
});



;
// END src/rider.js
